reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Qattan through Ali ibn Hatim al-Manqari to Hisham ibn Salim, whose name is glued to the verb in the text.
reasons.quote: حدثني علي بن حاتم المنقري، عن هشام بن سالمقال:

reasons.claim: Hisham asks Abu Abdillah and the Imam answers, making Abu Abdillah the last link.
reasons.quote: سألت أبا عبد الله عليه السلام

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters report from Ibn Uyaynah before the tahwil branches to Muhammad ibn Rafi, Ishaq (with an editorial gloss), and Malik.
reasons.quote: كلهم عن ابن عيينة، ح وحدثنا محمد بن رافع، حدثنا إسحاق، - يعني ابن عيسى - حدثنا مالك

reasons.claim: Both branches converge on al-Zuhri and close with a back-reference to the isnad of al-Layth.
The chain opens with the compiler's father and runs linearly through eight named transmitters, with relation words before Ali ibn Sayf and Sayf ibn Umayrah dropped.
reasons.quote: عن الحسين ابن سيف، عن أخيه علي بن سيف، عن أبيه سيف بن عميرة

reasons.claim: Abd al-Ala ibn Ayan questions Abu Abdillah who answers, making Abu Abdillah the last link.
reasons.quote: قلت لأبي عبد الله عليه السلام

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly from Yahya ibn Yahya through Malik, Ibn Shihab, and al-Araj to Abu Hurayrah.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، قال قرأت على مالك عن ابن شهاب، عن الأعرج، عن أبي هريرة

reasons.claim: The closing remark is Abu Hurayrah's own continuation on the same chain, so no second route is created.
The chain runs linearly from Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna through Abu Dawud, Shubah, and Qatadah to Anas.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن المثنى، حدثنا أبو داود، حدثنا شعبة، عن قتادة، قال سمعت أنسا

reasons.claim: Qatadah's follow-up question to Anas introduces no new transmitter and keeps the same route.
reasons.quote: قال قتادة قلت لأنس من أبو زيد

reasons.claim: The text opens with Ibn Shihab reporting from Said ibn Khalid ibn Amr ibn Uthman, with an aside omitted.
reasons.quote: قال ابن شهاب أخبرني سعيد بن خالد بن عمرو بن عثمان، وأنا أحدثه، هذا الحديث

reasons.claim: Said asks Urwah ibn al-Zubayr who answers by quoting Aishah, making Urwah and Aishah the final links before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: أنه سأل عروة بن الزبير عن الوضوء، مما مست النار فقال عروة سمعت عائشة

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly through four distinct transmitters joined by transmission particles and closes with a back-reference before the Prophet's saying.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِی مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارِ عَنْ یَعْقُوبَ بْنِ یَزِیدَ عَنِ الْعَمِّیِّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ

reasons.claim: The phrase indicating another unnamed transmitter mentioned before Haywah ibn Shurayh places that unnamed transmitter as a co-transmitter alongside Haywah rather than a sequential link between Haywah and Ayyash.
reasons.quote: عن حيوة بن شريح، وذكر، آخر قبله عن عياش بن عباس القتباني

reasons.claim: From Ayyash the chain continues through Shuyaym ibn Baytan to Ruwayfi ibn Thabit before the Prophet's saying.
reasons.quote: أن شييم بن بيتان، حدثه أنه، سمع رويفع بن ثابت

notes: «عن حيوة بن شريح، وذكر، آخر قبله عن عياش» places the unnamed transmitter as a co-transmitter with Haywah ibn Shurayh (mentioned before him), not a link between Haywah and Ayyash.

reviews.uncertainty_note: «وذكر، آخر قبله» is most naturally read as an unnamed co-transmitter mentioned before Haywah, though reading it as a sequential link is a possible alternative.

reasons.claim: The report opens with a back-reference to the preceding chain, which is written in prev2.
reasons.quote: 19 - وبهذا الإسناد قال: قال رسول الله

reasons.claim: The inherited chain in prev2 runs linearly through eight links ending at Ali, with the aliases of Ahmad ibn Abd Allah al-Juwaybari omitted.
reasons.quote: أحمد بن عبد الله الجويباري، ويقال له: الهروي والنهرواني والشيباني، عن الرضا علي بن موسى، عن أبيه، عن آبائه، عن علي

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Qutaybah to Yazid (omitting the identification gloss and the bracketed editorial insertion) to Shurayh ibn Hani and his father Hani.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا قتيبة، قال حدثنا يزيد، وهو ابن المقدام بن شريح ‏{‏عن أبيه،‏}‏ عن شريح بن هانئ، عن أبيه، هانئ
